title: Test non-mutating Fedora 43 Stream Deck host evidence

claims.statement: The accepted Companion adapter and complete-application evidence explicitly exclude USB access, physical Stream Deck discovery, physical key presses, rendered button pixels, and support outside their tested Linux boundaries.
claims.evidence: SPEC-0001 outOfScope, SPEC-0002 outOfScope, ADR-0003, ADR-0005, and implemented CHG-0005

claims.statement: On the target Fedora 43 host, lsusb enumerated one Elgato Stream Deck MK.2 as USB 0fd9:0080 and sysfs exposed the same HID identity through /dev/hidraw0 with mode 0660 and root:plugdev ownership.
claims.evidence: Host observations on 2026-07-25: lsusb, /sys/class/hidraw/hidraw0/device/uevent, udevadm info, stat, and principal group inspection

claims.statement: The unprivileged host principal opened and closed the matching hidraw node with both O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK and O_RDWR|O_NONBLOCK without reading or writing bytes; no owning process or Companion process was observed during the corrected formal inventory.
claims.evidence: Corrected schema-valid H-035 host inventory on 2026-07-25 with evidence SHA-256 06089e2bd553bf8bd83d61dd4f827a9392ec3dc2d20478aacc80a7ed763bde86

claims.statement: H-035: A host-bound, non-mutating collector on the exact Fedora 43 plus Stream Deck MK.2 target can reproducibly bind USB identity 0fd9:0080 to its current hidraw node, prove the unprivileged principal's effective access and open capability, distinguish no owner from an observation failure, and emit a hash-bound claim boundary without asserting Companion ownership or physical behavior.
claims.evidence: Doctrine-Driven Discovery framing authorized by @rodrigoteamx on 2026-07-25

claims.statement: The initial host observation supports the narrow precondition that an unprivileged process can attempt to acquire the MK.2 through the current hidraw node on this exact boot; it does not establish that Companion can acquire or recover the device.
claims.evidence: Corrected H-035 host inventory SHA-256 06089e2bd553bf8bd83d61dd4f827a9392ec3dc2d20478aacc80a7ed763bde86 and the accepted hardware evidence exclusions in ADR-0003 and ADR-0005

claims.statement: The Slice does not establish Companion ownership, key event delivery, rendered button pixels, USB unplug/replug recovery, reboot recovery, persistence, OverlayKit authority behavior, OBS truth, or operator perception.

Whether the production stack must be available before graphical login or only after user login remains unresolved and blocks a future physical-product specification, but it does not block this host-inventory evidence Slice.
claims.evidence: Human Doctrine Discovery handoff for Fedora 43 on 2026-07-25

successCriteria.statement: One run records the exact Fedora release, kernel, architecture, repository identity, principal UID/GID, and supplementary groups.
successCriteria.verification: Schema-valid H-035 host inventory generated on the physical Fedora 43 target.

successCriteria.statement: The collector binds every lsusb 0fd9:0080 observation to matching sysfs HID_ID and current hidraw nodes without assuming a stable bus, device number, or hidraw index.
successCriteria.verification: Fixture tests for HID parsing plus host lsusb, sysfs, udev, and device-node receipts.

successCriteria.statement: For every matching node, evidence records ownership, mode, effective read/write access, read-only and read-write nonblocking open results, and before/after identity metadata.
successCriteria.verification: Host inventory and verifier reject a missing node, failed access, failed open, or changed identity snapshot.

successCriteria.statement: Process ownership evidence distinguishes an observed empty owner set from unavailable tooling, nonzero errors, and identified owner processes.
successCriteria.verification: Structured fuser and process observations plus focused parser tests.

successCriteria.statement: The collector performs no reads from or writes to the HID node and changes no USB, udev, Companion, OBS, or OverlayKit configuration.
successCriteria.verification: Code review, open/close-only implementation, stable before/after device snapshots, and repository diff review.

successCriteria.statement: The machine-readable result is schema-valid, self-hashed, and explicitly separates proven preconditions from excluded product and physical-behavior claims.
successCriteria.verification: Strict JSON Schema validation, deterministic canonical-hash tests, and claim-boundary assertions.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0006 records H-035, typed claims, success criteria, and unknowns before any Companion ownership, key, pixel, reconnect, or startup experiment.
The Slice adds only host-inventory evidence tooling, focused tests, the proposed change contract, and deterministic generated governance artifacts.
A physical-host run and independent verifier satisfy SC-001 through SC-006 for the exact Fedora 43 plus Stream Deck MK.2 tuple.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Corrected H-035 host inventory SHA-256 06089e2bd553bf8bd83d61dd4f827a9392ec3dc2d20478aacc80a7ed763bde86; strict verifier passed for Fedora 43, one USB match, one hidraw match, stable identity, successful nonblocking opens, observed empty owner set, and no Companion process.

definitionOfDone.statement: Governance, quality, and build gates pass for the exact Slice tree under the repository's required Node 22 runtime.

No ADR, accepted hardware claim, product specification, implemented status, merge, USB rule, service configuration, or Companion configuration is created before separate human evidence review and acceptance.
